title: Work by electric field
description: Essential: The student must state the work done by the electric field force as -0.2 J, correctly applying W_e = -ΔE_p.

title: Potential difference U_AB
description: Essential: The student must calculate the potential difference as -10,000 V (or -1×10^4 V) using U_AB = W_AB / q.

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The student must determine the electric field strength magnitude as 1,000,000 V/m (or 1×10^6 V/m) using E = |U_AB| / d_parallel.

title: Field direction reasoning
description: Important: The student must deduce the electric field direction is vertically downward, reasoning from the increase in potential energy for a positive charge moved against the field.

title: Parallel distance calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly compute the parallel displacement (d = 0.01 m) using the given distance and the 60° angle.

title: Sign confusion in work
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly gives the work as +0.2 J, confusing the work done by the field with the work done against it.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award credit for correctly converting cm to m and maintaining consistent SI units throughout the calculation.

title: Vector vs. scalar handling
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student treats potential difference as a magnitude only, neglecting its sign, or misapplies the angle in the electric field formula.
